title: Project Health Score
description: Five-axis health score for a Node.js delivery project (blueprint §13-14). Each sub-score is 0-100 with a GREEN/YELLOW/RED rating and a one-line basis explaining how it was computed. The rollup is worst-of the five (a single RED forces a RED rollup). Baselined at M6 and recomputed on a schedule thereafter; surfaced on the Master dashboard for retainer monitoring. Rating bands (default): GREEN >= 80, YELLOW 60-79, RED < 60.

project.description: Client slug or project ID this score belongs to.

architecture_health.description: How well the codebase holds its intended shape. Computed from architecture fitness-test pass rate (controller/service/repository boundaries, no DB access outside repositories, API-version enforcement, queue retry caps), cyclomatic/complexity hotspots, and count of boundary violations. GREEN = all fitness tests pass and no new boundary debt.

test_health.description: Confidence the test suite gives. Computed from line/branch coverage vs target, presence of API contract tests, integration/contract tests vs ERP+store sandboxes, webhook idempotency/replay tests, and sync-specific tests (missed-run, overlapping-run, watermark-resume). Flaky-test rate subtracts. GREEN = coverage at target and all required test classes present and green.

dependency_health.description: Freshness and safety of the dependency tree. Computed from outdated-dependency count (majors behind), known-vulnerability count from OSV-Scanner/npm audit, and EOL runtime/library usage. GREEN = no high/critical advisories and few majors behind.

security_health.description: Security posture. Computed from OWASP-API check results, authz coverage (every tenant-scoped query scoped), secret-scan/SAST/DAST findings, secrets-management correctness (no inline secrets, rotation in place), and severity of open security findings. Any open high/critical finding caps this RED.

delivery_health.description: Delivery/operational momentum. Computed from gate SLA adherence, budget burn (hours_burned vs hours_budget, token_used vs token_cap), open P1/P2 bug count and age, sync error/alert rate, runbook completeness, and SLO/SLA attainment in monitoring. GREEN = on-budget, no aged P1/P2s, SLOs met, runbooks present.

rollup.description: Overall rating = worst of the five sub-ratings. One RED forces RED; otherwise one YELLOW forces YELLOW; else GREEN.

rating.description: Band of the value. Default bands: GREEN >= 80, YELLOW 60-79, RED < 60. A hard cap (e.g. an open critical security finding) may force RED regardless of value.

basis.description: One-line explanation of how this sub-score was computed for this run, e.g. 'fitness 12/12 pass, 0 boundary violations, 1 complexity hotspot'.
